regions.merged_text: Pray to the good Lord for guidance, and to guide all concerned. If your Sisters and inlaws want to do something to promote justice and peace, they should join you in prayer for guideance while you consult a confessor, a priest. But you must turn a deaf ear to any other dictations. You took care of your mother and dad through the grace of God, and God in His goodness arranged for you to have the homestead because of your kind- ness to your mother and Dad. So in all justice you should keep what the Good Lord arranged for you to have.
